packageRules.description: Safe in-range npm updates (minor, patch, lockfile) in one PR. Majors are deliberately left out so each can be reviewed or rejected on its own.
All GitHub Actions bumps in one PR.
Stay below ESLint 9. This repo uses .eslintrc.json; ESLint 10 dropped eslintrc support entirely and 9 deprecates it, so both need a flat-config migration first. Remove this rule once that is done.
